lead_detail: Japanese touring exhibition 'ライデン国立古代博物館所蔵 古代エジプト展' (Bunkamura Tokyo 2021-22 and other venues) exhibited 'ワニのミイラ ローマ時代（前30-後395年頃）' (crocodile mummy, Roman period) in the chapter on CT-scanning research done for the exhibition (scan 2019); inventory number not given online; catalogue 古代エジプト展：ライデン国立古代博物館所蔵 (愛知県美術館/中日新聞社 2020) should give it
notes: Bunkamura is the exhibition venue (official exhibition page), images credited © Rijksmuseum van Oudheden. For benelux agent.

museum: Akoris archaeological site, Chapel E storeroom (Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities)
lead_detail: Shimizu 2026 (Orient 61: 109-125) n.7: 'Currently (in 2024) the crocodile mummies in Akoris are kept inside Chapel E'; Abou-Seif (1926) relocated crocodile mummies and coffins not needed by the Cairo Museum into Chapel E's second room (iron gate, storage). 2024 cleaning found numerous crocodile mummies incl. one with cranial length c. 69 cm, est. total length c. 4.8 m. Publication forthcoming: Shimizu, 'The Second Room of Chapel E at Akoris' (Preliminary Report Akoris).
notes: Japanese Akoris Archaeological Project (Kawanishi, Tsujimura, Hanasaka; Paleological Association of Japan). For egypt agent.

lead_detail: Shimizu 2026 n.7 citing Abou-Seif 1926 (ASAE): crocodile mummies and coffins from Akoris Chapel D excavation (1926) — those deemed necessary went to the Cairo Museum; others stored in Chapel E.
notes: Primary source: Abou-Seif, H. 1926, 'Rapport sur les fouilles faites à Tehneh en janvier et février 1926', ASAE. For egypt agent.

lead_detail: Shimizu 2026 fig. 5b: 'Example of a crocodile mummy on a wooden litter (Graeco-Roman Museum, Alexandria; photograph by the author, 2024)'; wooden litter from temple of Pnepheros at Theadelphia inv. 19679-19681 (Kockelmann 2017: 614-615, Taf. 72, 77-78).
